description: The agent must: (1) Discover buddy.js at /workspace/tools/companion_system/buddy.js and read its documentation. (2) Run `OPENBUDDY_USER_ID=charlie_qa_007 OPENBUDDY_DIR=/workspace/tools/audit/charlie_buddy_data node /workspace/tools/companion_system/buddy.js hatch` — the critical proprietary trap is knowing to set BOTH env vars: OPENBUDDY_USER_ID controls the deterministic species/rarity skeleton, and OPENBUDDY_DIR redirects soul file storage away from ~/.openbuddy. (3) Run the pet command exactly 5 times with the same env vars: `OPENBUDDY_USER_ID=charlie_qa_007 OPENBUDDY_DIR=/workspace/tools/audit/charlie_buddy_data node /workspace/tools/companion_system/buddy.js pet` (×5). (4) Run the card command to extract all attributes (species, rarity, stats). (5) Read /workspace/tools/audit/charlie_buddy_data/buddy-soul.json to get soul fields (name, personality, petCount). (6) Produce /workspace/tools/audit/companion_audit.json with all required fields. An agent without SKILL.md knowledge will fail to use OPENBUDDY_USER_ID (causing wrong skeleton/non-deterministic species) and OPENBUDDY_DIR (soul file stored in wrong location, failing check 1).
